title: Application & Supply-Chain Security (SLSA) — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Breakglass Emergency Deployment: illustrates emergency override procedures when immediate production fixes must bypass Binary Authorization gates.
routing_rationale: Breakglass procedures allow authorized on-call engineers to deploy emergency hotfixes during major outages, while generating immutable audit logs for post-incident review.

nodes.label: Emergency Hotfix Container
nodes.detail: Lead engineer crafts urgent 2-line database deadlock fix during $50k/min outage.

nodes.label: Breakglass Override Annotation
nodes.detail: Pod manifest explicitly asserts emergency breakglass permission.

nodes.label: BinAuth Admission Controller
nodes.detail: Permits unsigned container pod creation due to breakglass annotation.

nodes.label: Security Incident Audit Log
nodes.detail: Logs exact engineer identity, timestamp, and container SHA to Cloud Audit Logs.

steps.title: Emergency Breakglass Assertion
steps.action: Engineer deploys hotfix with breakglass annotation; admission controller admits pod.
steps.why_traversal: Provides operational escape hatch to resolve critical business outages.

steps.title: Audit Accountability
steps.action: Cloud Audit Logs records breakglass event; security alerts are triggered for mandatory retrospective.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees emergency overrides cannot be used secretly or maliciously without audit trail.

scenarios.label: Unauthorized Engineer Denied Breakglass Access
scenarios.diverted_path: Admission controller rejects deployment; pod fails to start.
scenarios.blast_radius: Only vetted emergency response personnel can activate breakglass.
scenarios.recovery: Designated on-call lead engineer with required breakglass role must execute the deployment.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
